为什么多个数据源给出的归属地不同？: Why do sources report different locations?

ISP names may refer to a data center or upstream network. Compare country, city, ISP and ASN instead of relying only on the city. Proxies, mobile networks, cloud servers and address reassignment can all create differences between database records and actual use.
ASN、运营商和地址类型分别是什么？: What are ASN, ISP and address type?
ASN 标识负责路由该地址的自治系统；运营商表示数据源记录的网络组织；IPv4、: An ASN identifies the autonomous system routing the address. ISP is the network organization recorded by the source. IPv4 and IPv6 indicate the protocol version. One ISP may have multiple ASNs and one ASN may span multiple cities. The registered organization, routing operator and end user are not always the same entity; an organization name does not identify a device or person.
为什么风险评分或部分字段没有显示？: Why are risk scores or some fields missing?

Scores and VPN/proxy labels reflect a particular source's assessment and are not a standalone security conclusion. Fields may be absent because a source omitted them, a query failed or a service is not configured. Do not read “unknown” as “no” or zero risk.
